scope: One final PNG/SVG and its 16 plotted scalar comparisons; no new simulation, code change, review tree, or convergence gate.
visual_inspection: Read both panels from the generated PNG. Axis labels, legends, target labels, title and bottom notes are readable; no overlap or clipping observed. SVG source text and artifact hashes are bound through the figure receipt.

data_interpretation.selected_geometry_case: SIGNED_MINUS; the separately completed SIGNED_PLUS matrix case is not plotted here.
data_interpretation.left_count: N_surv; plotted absolute relative error is |N-N_ref|/|N_ref|.
data_interpretation.left_age1: Raw unnormalized surviving-age measure M1=sum N_surv,b*(t1-t_birth); quantity age_sum_com_s. It is not mean age M1/N_surv.
data_interpretation.left_age2: Raw unnormalized measure M2=sum N_surv,b*(t1-t_birth)^2; quantity age2_sum_com_s2. It is not normalized mean squared age M2/N_surv.
data_interpretation.left_controls: All four cases hold path slabs=4, opacity degree=8 and event degree=16; the birth-rule categories differ. Categorical horizontal placement and unconnected markers make no formal-order claim.
data_interpretation.targets: The count1e-8 and raw-age1/2=1e-7 guide lines match the declared bounded diagnostic targets. They are not universal physical error bounds.
data_interpretation.right_controls: Both cases hold Gauss degree8/refinement1 births and opacity8/event16; only path slabs4 vs8 differ.
data_interpretation.right_normalization: Both marker series plot |W-W_ref|/|W_ref|. The direct-integral and energy-subtraction series use the same independently computed W_ref.
data_interpretation.cancellation_scope: Source energy is approximately6.42e5 times |W_ref|. Small source-normalized energy closure is not work-relative accuracy, as the note correctly states.
data_interpretation.precision_scope: Very small Gauss comparison points are measured finite differences against a numerical reference; caption correctly excludes rigorous whole-operator interval bounds and universal nonlinear-history convergence.
